def find_tuples(tuples_list, k):
    """
    Return all tuples from `tuples_list` where every element is divisible by `k`.
    
    Example:
        assert find_tuples([(6, 24, 12), (7, 9, 6), (12, 18, 21)], 6) == [(6, 24, 12)]
    """
    return [t for t in tuples_list if all(x % k == 0 for x in t)]


# Example usage and assertion:
if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert find_tuples([(6, 24, 12), (7, 9, 6), (12, 18, 21)], 6) == [(6, 24, 12)]
    print(find_tuples([(6, 24, 12), (7, 9, 6), (12, 18, 21)], 6))

# Output: [(6, 24, 12)]
